subject: A trick for your {{topic}}
preview_text: Make your thesis sound less like AI with this one weird action.
body_paragraphs: Hey {{first_name}}, remember how you used Thesis Generator to build your outline and draft? Here's a power move you might have missed: the "enhance" action can make your AI-generated text sound less like a robot and more like you.

Next time you're working on your {{work_type}}, try selecting a section and hitting "enhance" with a note like "rewrite this in my voice" or "add a citation to Smith 2020." It injects a specific reference style or tone mid-generation, breaking the generic AI feel.
Give it a shot—it's a game changer for making your {{work_type}} feel original and polished.
